questions.stem: Which of the following is a false statement regarding the inguinal canal?

options.label: A
options.text: Conjoint tendon forms a part of the posterior wall

options.label: B
options.text: Superficial ring is an opening in the external oblique aponeurosis

options.label: C
options.text: Deep ring is an opening in the transverse abdominis

options.label: D
options.text: Internal oblique forms both the anterior and superior walls
